intro: PediAid's PALS Algorithms screen is described in-app as a way to 'tap any algorithm to open it directly in the PDF viewer' for Pediatric Advanced Life Support. Rather than reimplementing each algorithm as interactive steps, it acts as a table of contents into a bundled PALS reference PDF, jumping straight to the correct page for whichever algorithm is selected.
indications: Quickly opening the correct PALS algorithm page during a pediatric emergency such as cardiac arrest, bradycardia, or tachycardia
Reviewing the systematic approach or post-arrest care algorithms during training or a case debrief
Locating the foreign body airway obstruction sequence for a choking infant or child
Refresher review of shock recognition and post-ROSC management between courses
method: The screen lists 10 named algorithms, each mapped to a specific page number in a bundled PALS PDF: Pediatric Cardiac Arrest, Bradycardia with Pulse, Tachycardia with Pulse, Septic Shock, Management of Shock After ROSC, Length-Based Resuscitation, PALS Systematic Approach, Post-Cardiac Arrest Care, Child Foreign Body Airway Obstruction, and Infant Foreign Body Airway Obstruction. Tapping an entry opens the PDF viewer directly at that algorithm's page rather than presenting a separate interactive tool.

faqs.q: What algorithms are included in PediAid's PALS section?
faqs.a: Pediatric Cardiac Arrest, Bradycardia with Pulse, Tachycardia with Pulse, Septic Shock, Management of Shock After ROSC, Length-Based Resuscitation, PALS Systematic Approach, Post-Cardiac Arrest Care, Child Foreign Body Airway Obstruction, and Infant Foreign Body Airway Obstruction.

faqs.q: Does tapping an algorithm open a separate calculator?
faqs.a: No -- it opens the bundled PALS algorithm PDF directly at the relevant page through the app's PDF viewer.

faqs.q: Is there a foreign body airway obstruction algorithm for infants specifically?
faqs.a: Yes -- the list includes separate entries for Child Foreign Body Airway Obstruction and Infant Foreign Body Airway Obstruction.

faqs.q: Can I jump straight to post-cardiac-arrest care guidance?
faqs.a: Yes -- 'Post-Cardiac Arrest Care' is a direct entry in the list, opening straight to its page in the PDF.
